profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Developer experienced in solving problems and driving success across teams and knowledge areas.

Comfortable with React/Redux, GraphQL, Node.js, SQL, Python, etc. 

Committed to growing and learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborate in an Agile environment to define and implement features for Domino’s next generation enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform.
• Pair program and perform code reviews to improve code quality, eliminate defects and accelerate problem solving
• As part of a dedicated team of roughly 8 UI developers, helped maintain and enhance over 3 dozen shared components and JavaScript libraries
• Collaborated on GraphQL API/query design with developers working on our C#/.NET front end presentation layer

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Clients range from small family-owned businesses to foundations.  

With a focus on helping businesses do business better:
•  Write formal contract bid and grant proposals
• Develop logos, websites and a social media presence
• Bring book keeping, payments, including estimates and invoicing online
• Draft board documents, annual reports, impact assessments
• Analyze industry relevant data to guide business decisions

positions.title: Education Program Manager
positions.description:
•Managed a portfolio of school/organization partnerships worth more than $12MM as part of a citywide
community schools initiative, with responsibility for developing a work plan and providing
comprehensive budget oversight support

• Provided targeted resources to community school directors at 15 sites to lower absenteeism rates,
bolster academic progress, improve health and wellness services, and strengthen family engagement
at each school

• Facilitated knowledge sharing between sites to encourage implementation of best practices program-wide, and encouraged decision making focused on capacity building and sustainability

company.name: United Way of New York City

positions.title: Associate, Partnership Development
positions.description:
• Oversaw the life cycle of contracts with public agencies across New York, Newark, and Washington, D.C., including pre-qualification, reporting, and coordination of the invoicing process

• Educated organization leaders on federal, state, and local legislation and political climates to aid in strategic decision-making on issues relating to program expansion and funding

• Created and managed project plans, and coordinated work across multiple departments to execute partner relationships, grants, and contracts

positions.title: Program Assistant
positions.description:
•Led the process of selecting partner schools as recipients of a $2.7MM grant from the Helmsley
Charitable Trust, ensuring each school met criteria designed to identify successful implementers of a
rigorous school improvement model

educations.fieldOfStudy: French Studies; Middle Eastern Studies / Minor: Public Policy (Social Agenda & Inequality)
